pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-rectangular dark regions with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Individual patches show internal color variance with darker centers and lighter, blurred perimeter pixels.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-tan interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, exhibiting narrowing at junction nodes and widening along the lateral flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a brush-like 1D silhouette with regular, low-amplitude vertical spikes against the background foliage, extending from the mid-neck to the shoulder apex.
